activate_when: The core problem has been defined and the domain is concrete and human-facing.
Relationship, negotiation, communication, cooperation, organization, personal growth, or public expression dynamics shape the next action.
General analysis needs scenario-specific rules about signals, incentives, control, or influence.
do_not_activate_when: The issue is purely technical, mechanical, or factual.
There is not enough context to identify a scenario and a safe assumption would be misleading.
The user is using a scenario label to justify unsupported certainty.
red_flags: A signal is treated as a guarantee.
Game theory is used to assume hostility.
The answer tries to control an outcome instead of choosing controllable action.
The scenario model becomes an excuse for over-inference.
